Name: Coconut Addon
Author: Kjay9558
Description:
This is for your Coconut needs:

[list]
[*]Coconuts can now be planted
[*]Coconut Saplings are produced by a seed maker, if you throw a coconut in it (if you don't want that feature, download the optional file insted)
[*]Gus sells four delicious coconut cooking recipes: coconut cookies, coconut cake, coconut water and coconut flesh
[*]Sandy sells the coconut sapling in her shop

[/list]
You need to install:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Json Assets
[*]Space Core (for Json Assets to work)
[*]Expanded Preconditions Utility (for Json Assets to work)
[*]PFM - Producer Framework Mod
[/list]
Check out my sourcecode on  [url=http://https://github.com/Kjay9558/Coconut-Tree]gitHub[/url]﻿.

Thank you to the lovely people on [url=https://discord.com/invite/3QkGQNH]spacechase0's Mod server
[/url]﻿for their immediate feedback and great ideas!

My mods are absolutely free to use, but if you want to send me a little tip, you can do so on [url=https://paypal.me/pools/c/8yvwUe8acP]PayPal[/url]﻿.
